resources.string: Lica Player needs access to the audio and video on your device to build your library. Nothing leaves your phone.
The phone\'s audio chip plays the music while the processor sleeps. Track changes may have a tiny gap. The screen runs at 60 Hz.
Saves battery with the audio chip only when tracks still play back to back without gaps. Recommended.
Full-precision audio (32-bit) for hi-res files, no battery savings. For audiophiles.
